decision: Sam, project manager chat 01a0e71b-fccb-7c81-b9fe-ed817cc58e1f on 2026-11-02: all non-functional tests after UAT; new routine tests and workload growth need prior approval.
purpose: Keep the admission controller and deliver functional CI before UAT. Gate existing capacity on post-UAT grants for a related diff.
data: Git trees, blob identities and classification receipts. No new application cases or dataset.
concurrency: One static admission per candidate. Existing application and capacity worker limits retained.
repetitions: One admission per candidate; exact dispatched PR results are reusable.
thresholds: Missing approval/classification blocks execution; existing test thresholds and coverage floors preserved.
trigger: PR, main and schedule run functional CI. Only a manual main dispatch with an externally approved post-UAT base/head/case can start capacity.
cost: Existing static selection and functional gates. Zero capacity runners on feature PRs; no added routine application test.
